product: SBA Lender Match / Shopify affiliate research comparison

baseline.why: Internal evidence comparison only; this does not predict approval or replace lender underwriting.

variant.why: Internal evidence comparison only; this does not predict approval or replace lender underwriting.

lesson.what_we_expected: A meaningful business-presence change would alter the internal gap analysis while unknown underwriting fields remain unknown.
lesson.what_actually_happened: Baseline returned GAP with cash-flow unknown; the variant added a business-identity gap without turning unknowns into a rejection.
lesson.why_we_think_it_happened: The comparison preserves claim-specific evidence and distinguishes a supplied mismatch from missing lender-variable evidence.
lesson.what_changed_in_nexus_knowledge: Clyde can produce pass/gap/unknown guidance from official and product evidence without making an approval prediction.
lesson.what_to_do_differently_next_time: Collect lender-specific cash-flow and product-term evidence before making a stronger fit recommendation.

next_research_request: Acquire current lender-specific cash-flow, fees, and guarantee terms for a selected product.
